dedupe_keys.name: cropgrids global geo referenced harvested and physical area of 173 crops circa 2020 at 0 05 degrees

description: Global gridded maps of harvested area and crop (physical) area for 173 crops around 2020, at 0.05 degrees (about 5.6 km at the equator). The figshare record says CROPGRIDS is a major update of the Monfreda et al. (2008) dataset, which covered 175 crops for about 2000 at 10 km, built by expanding that dataset with 28 published gridded datasets from mostly 2015 to 2020 and scaling to FAOSTAT national statistics for 2020, and that it is described in Tang, Nguyen, Conchedda, Casse, Tubiello and Maggi (Scientific Data). Version 9 of 24 April 2024 (CROPGRIDS v1.08) holds downloadable NetCDF maps (about 807 MB zipped), PNG maps (135 MB), a country table in Excel, crop codes, the data paper and a distribution note, free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is global cropland. Caveats: a single reference year, and crop placement for crops without recent gridded sources still leans on the older Monfreda patterns. For simulation it gives the area of each crop in each grid cell, to estimate the crops exposed to floods, droughts and heat, the water demand of irrigated crops and the flows that rural roads, storage and processing plants must carry. Related catalogue records include EarthStat global agricultural geodata (Monfreda) and the FAO cropland agreement map.
